title: Chapter 150 The Beginning Of Fame
content:
Chapter 150 The Beginning Of Fame

Running fast all the way, in addition to sending a person to notify, the group of hidden guards who were still in the Zuixian Tower asked them to hide and sneak out of the city before reuniting with me.

As for Zhong Yu and his party, they used the token they had just obtained from Lord Yanchun to open the closed gate of the capital city, and rode their horses far away to the north.

"Chirp!" A sharp and mournful hawk chirped, startling the sky and suppressing the clouds, causing a burst of birds to fly.

On Zhong Yu's shoulder, a majestic condor flew towards the sky, with a small scroll tied on its golden claws, flying towards the direction of the northern Yu Kingdom.

On the cliff, Zhu Ma stopped.

"Your Majesty, are we really going to attack the Yan Kingdom so quickly? Will this arouse the vigilance of the other six countries?" Zhao Yun was a little worried.

"It's just as early as possible. Although our strength is a little insufficient, the whole country can still gather his 300,000 troops. Compared with Qin's one million troops, Qi and Chu's 800,000 troops are somewhat insufficient. But to deal with This area is weak with 300,000 troops, and with our elite army and sufficient combat readiness, and now that we have this order, it is still a piece of cake!" The scroll in Yang Yang's hand contained the two soldiers who were previously called Yanchun Jun. An order written by someone, with this, I can easily swallow the entire Liaodong.

"Your Majesty is right. With this order, only 100,000 troops are needed to go south to annex Liaodong. At that time, the 300,000 people and 80,000 troops in Liaodong can all become the people of my Great Yu Kingdom and serve my country well." It is used by the Imperial Kingdom!" Zhang Fei has always been belligerent, so naturally he would not disapprove of this order.

"A 100,000 army can take Liaodong, but if you want to go further west, to more places in the country of Yan, 100,000 troops are far from enough!" Smiling, Zhong Yu meant something.

"Could it be that your Majesty wants to destroy Yan State in one fell swoop? Even if we can break through Liaodong without any loss, it will be very difficult to perish even if we don't expect it! After all, there is still an army of nearly 200,000 in the direction of the capital of Yan State, not to mention counterattack , even if they defend the city with all their strength, they will not be able to break through their capital!" Zhao Yun couldn't help but feel a little worried when he thought of his majesty's great accomplishments in the past, and persuaded him.

"Don't worry, Zilong. Although I am a little arrogant, I am not unreasonable. This time, I did not intend to destroy Yan State in one fell swoop. Instead, I planned to take down the three counties in the east of Yan State, Liaodong, Liaoxi, and Youbeiping. The strength has been weakened to the current level of South Korea, and it can no longer pose a threat to our country!" Zhong Yu slowly said his plan, which made Zhao Yun and others much less worried.

"But Your Majesty, if you do this, will it completely anger the country of Yan? After all, this is half of their country. Even though these three counties belong to a sparsely populated land, they still have nearly 1/3 of the population of the country of Yan, right? You can abandon it if you say so!" Although I heard that my Majesty did not intend to destroy the Yan Kingdom, I was still surprised when I heard His Majesty's plan!

"That's why I want to bring more troops. This time, I plan to deploy 200,000 people to take advantage of Yan's unpreparedness and quickly break through the three counties. Directly coerce the soldiers of the three counties and the main force of our country. The soldiers came under the capital of the Yan Kingdom, and threatened the Yan Kingdom with majesty, making it submissive!" Zhong Yu said domineeringly.

The three counties in the east of Yan State, Liaodong have 80,000 troops, and the two counties of Youbeiping and Youbeiping in the west of Liaoning also have 20,000 to 30,000 troops stationed. Withdrawing 100,000 from it, he left his 50,000 troops to garrison the three counties, and then 250,000 troops to overwhelm Yandu.

At this time, even if the Yan Kingdom exhausted all the strong men, it could only draw 200,000 men at most. There are not all good men, so how can it be an opponent of its own 250,000 army? At that time, I will plunder near Yandu, plunder the population of Yan and return to western Liaoning.

Then he was intimidating the cowardly king of the Yan Kingdom and the fatuous Lord Yanchun to make them agree with their current status and strength, and the fact that the three eastern counties were occupied.

With its current army of 250,000, the Yan Kingdom must not dare to take the initiative to attack. Under more threats, it must be an established fact that it will not shrink back.

It's just that for all of this, you need to have an elite army, attack all the way, attack with the fastest speed, and break through Yan to attack the blocking army, so that Yan will create an illusion that the enemy's army is extremely powerful and will never be yourself. The army can be compared.

At that time, then I can become famous all over the world, let the seven heroes of the Warring States know the north, and rise up a big country that is comparable to the three kingdoms of Chu and Qin.

You can also use this reputation to recruit talents from all over the world, and collect all kinds of people with high military strength or outstanding people to serve your own kingdom.

Especially the top masters, the only place where their imperial country is weaker than the other six countries.

There are more than two hundred first-rate masters in the world's fourth rank, and there are more than a hundred of them belonging to various countries.

The remaining nearly a hundred masters wandered in the rivers and lakes, or belonged to various schools and gangs, or wandered alone.

If I can win over a school, or lure those scattered people with their glory and wealth, and make them work for me, then the top power of my Imperial Kingdom will definitely increase dramatically in a short period of time.

…………

Liaoxi County, the northernmost part of it, originally belonged to Chifeng, an area of East Lake.

At this moment, a majestic city has been built in this place, and all the facilities are perfect. Tens of thousands of people live and work here in peace and contentment, and build new homes.

However, all of these are not his most special places. It is not surprising that there are places like this in all parts of the imperial kingdom.

The reason why he was specifically mentioned is that this county called Chifeng has already stationed his 50,000 troops at the moment, all of which are used by the imperial state to defend against the Yan state, and to prepare for the southward invasion of the Yan state.

At this moment, in this heavily guarded and majestic barracks, an eagle hovered above his sky, and it blew a few times.

From an inconspicuous small tent in the barracks, a man dressed strangely walked out, put his index finger and thumb into his mouth, and blew a long whistle, attracting the eagle down.

The man untied a scroll from the eagle's leg, and instead of checking it on his own initiative, he quickly released the eagle and ran towards the large tent of the Chinese army.

And the eagle circled a few times in the air again, flapped its wings and flew towards its other destination.

One day later, Tongliao City, the northernmost part of Liaodong Province and the southern border of Yuguo, and the guard in the city at this moment also received the scroll brought by this eagle.

In the two cities, the troops who had just arrived in January moved again. Under the orders of the officers, one by one, they put on their battle armors again, held their spears, and rode their healthy horses towards the city. The country of Yan in the south of them, marched.

The eagle also came to its last destination, the current temporary capital of Yu Kingdom, Changchun City.
